title: podolepis gracilis f. rosea
intro: Podolepis gracilis f. rosea, commonly known as Pink Podolepis, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is native to Australia and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body, and its therapeutic actions include reducing fever and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents of Podolepis gracilis f. rosea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
